name: pair-pal
description: Shows the Command Center agent's own presence (caret, selection, follow mode) in your editor while it walks you through a review — never moves your real cursor.

commandCenter.apiUrl.description: Base URL of the local Command Center API.

commandCenter.sessionId.description: The review/walkthrough id to connect to. Set per-workspace once Command Center hands this out automatically; until then, set it by hand to smoke-test.
